reviews.comment: Inadequate teacher, poorly prepared students for tests/quizzes

Dr. Bengali was super great! His lectures were pretty clear and easy to follow, and he used iClicker questions to help students practice as he was teaching. With just a bit of studying and work, it's not very hard to get an A. The quizzes were much harder than the exams, but the homework had 10 attempts per question and would explain each problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a good professor, near the end he started making things more confusing to understand. Clicker questions are a big part of the class, lots of annoying homework things on OWL Cengage, exams were fairly similar to practice exams.

He's a good professor, and if you don't know much chem make sure to do the hw and listen to the lectures very properly if you want to get an A in the class. His student hours are very helpful and he shows that he cares about his students very well. Participation matters since there's iclicker

Bengali was the goat. Went into the class not sure what to expect (his first semester teaching in CStat) and everything went really well. He's really funny and a great teacher. Only caution is to stay on top of everything as the class gets harder as it goes along. Thought I was doing fine and my Exam 2 grade was 20 points lower. Also uses iClicker.

Dr. Bengali did a great job of answering questions and showing that he genuinely cared about his students. He always made sure to stop and answer a question if there were any and he very clearly articulated the material. Dr. Bengali made this class so much more fun and interesting. I will definitely take him again if I get the opportunity.
Dr.Bengali's class was very interesting. His class is very lecture-based, so going to class is very helpful. He does record his lectures, though.

The course content is sometimes hard to grasp, but he does a great job of explaining it. He uses in-class polls to make sure students are following and will go back and review if a lot of people don't seem to be. He definitely cares about his students and his teaching!
Dr. Bengali was the lab coordinator and he was very helpful and kind. He did a good job organizing the lab and the project he introduced was graded leniently as a "curve". Would take again :)

Overall enjoyed his lectures. If you did not taken AP chem, like me, read the lecture slides before class/teach yourself the general concepts/topics before class to make following the lecture easier. Fairly often he would rush the end of the lecture because of time so focus on reviewing the end of the lecture slides after class.

If you took AP Chem this class will be very easy. Attendance is basically mandatory (you can miss a few classes and not have your grade lowered). Prof had really good, easy to understand lectures and had some funny jokes here and there. The homework doesn't take very long and was actually pretty helpful. I would definitely take Dr. Bengali again.

Great professor, honestly wish I had paid more attention and taken better notes in class because that was the only reason I did not end up with a higher grade. He does have graded polling in class that makes it mandatory to be there every lecture however that will help you in the long run and give you a reason to go every time. Overall awesome.

Dr. Bengali explains concepts in such a way that both engaging and detailed. Mock exams were provided for all three exams, and he always stressed his availability for office hours. Additionally, our TA's supplement review sessions were very beneficial. I had as good as a time one can have in a gen chem class and couldn't recommend Dr. Bengali more.

Although the chemistry topics are difficult, if you  go to office hours and review sessions you'll be fine. If you're not actively listening you will be confused all lecture so pay attention. There are I clickers so attendance is mandatory. The course schedule is also very easy to follow. Definitely recommend taking class with him!

Dr. Bengali was an amazing professor to have. He made lectures engaging, he gives great mock exams, always has office hours, and his tests are extremely fair. Definitely will need to use your resources and study outside of class, but his lecture slides make that easy. I had an amazing IA and I went to her session every week.

Dr. Bengali is a really good professor and very easy to communicate with. The class itself is very challenging but he tries to make the lectures as in depth as possible. He rushes a lot near the end of a class period which can be overwhelming. But as long as you do the homework properly and study for the tests you should be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are very in depth and well explained. Class is extremely structured which is incredibly helpful for note taking. The content can be fairly challenging, however it is not at the fault of the professor, just the scope of the class itself. Very good professor.

Great professor which should be actively sought out after when selecting classes. He has engaging and organized notes planned for each lecture and will frequently stop to answer questions. Homework assigned didn't ever take THAT long, and was never extremely difficult in my opinion. I recommend attending the lectures as they are very helpful.

I had Bengali for Chem 107. He did a great job of keeping students engaged in lectures and making class as enjoyable as he can for such a hard topic. His classes are mandatory, but he is a much better lecturer than the other professors I heard of. Just show up and complete the homeworks and you should not have any problem making a good grade.

the chemistry department at a&m is notoriously bad but this dude is actually THE GOAT OAT. talked to him a few times and he's super chill and lectures very well. the exams are definitely easy if you know what you are doing and review cengage homework. homework assignments were 3-6 due once a week. a few quizzes on monday's every now and then. love.

He's a chill guy and very helpful during office hours. His lectures are easy to understand and he goes through the material at a reasonable pace. The homework felt kind of a lot but it's manageable if you don't procrastinate. Clicker questions are a must.

Bengali is a bro, I personally really hate chemistry so I struggled but still managed to get a B. I STRESS THIS: ATTEND EVERY LECTURE!!! And pay very close attention because while his lectures are good, if you zone out you WILL get lost fast. Overall, he's a great guy and I would definitely recommend him, but just pay attention and take good notes.

His lectures are engaging, he cares about his students, and his notes are detailed and organized. Tests aren't too difficult and the homework is very reasonable considering it's an engineering chemistry course.
